
declare namespace tools {
  /**
   * Instant indexed whole-disk or workspace file search (<0.1ms). Strict deterministic matching (zero typo tolerance) for exact symbol, glob, and path resolution. Supports globs (src/**/*.{ts,tsx}), extension filters (*.rs), git status filters (git:modified, git:staged, git:untracked), and proximity re-ranking (near: <path>). Scoped strictly to the active worktree root.
   */
  function ultrasearch_query(args: {
    /** Search query, glob, or filter (e.g. 'Omnibox *.swift', 'git:modified') */
    query: string;
    /** Max results (default: 30) */
    limit?: number;
    /** Search whole disk instead of workspace */
    global?: boolean;
    /** Optional file path to re-rank results by folder proximity */
    near?: string;
    /** Optional server-side deadline (ms); partial results carry complete:false */
    budget_ms?: number;
  }): Promise<{
    matches: Array<{
      path: string;
      relPath: string;
      kind: "file" | "dir" | "link";
      score: number;
      git?: string;
    }>;
    took_us: number;
  }>;

  /**
   * Indexed trigram text search inside files (<1ms). Clean compact output with enterprise DLP credential masking.
   */
  function ultrasearch_grep(args: {
    /** Literal or identifier to search */
    pattern: string;
    /** Subdirectory or file filter */
    path_filter?: string;
    /** Search whole disk instead of restricting to the current scope */
    global?: boolean;
    /** Search mode (semantic = intent keyword expansion) */
    mode?: "literal" | "regex" | "symbol" | "semantic";
    /** Max files to return */
    limit?: number;
    /** Compact one-line format (default: true) */
    compact?: boolean;
    /** Optional token budget ceiling */
    max_tokens?: number;
    /** Lines of surrounding code context (0-5, default: 0) */
    context?: number;
    /** Tag matches with AST definition types like [def:fn], [def:class] */
    tag_symbols?: boolean;
    /** Optional server-side deadline (ms); partial results carry complete:false */
    budget_ms?: number;
  }): Promise<{
    files: Array<{
      path: string;
      matches: Array<{ line: number; text: string }>;
    }>;
    took_us: number;
  }>;

  /**
   * Simultaneous multi-pattern OR content retrieval across trigram index in one call.
   */
  function ultrasearch_multi_grep(args: {
    /** Array of search patterns */
    patterns: string[];
    /** Subdirectory filter */
    path_filter?: string;
    /** Max files to return */
    limit?: number;
    /** Compact one-line format (default: true) */
    compact?: boolean;
    /** Optional token budget ceiling */
    max_tokens?: number;
    /** Optional server-side deadline (ms); partial results carry complete:false */
    budget_ms?: number;
  }): Promise<{
    files: Array<{
      path: string;
      matches: Array<{ line: number; text: string }>;
    }>;
    took_us: number;
  }>;

  /**
   * Instant O(1) filename lookup (e.g. 'package.json', 'Cargo.toml') within current workspace.
   */
  function ultrasearch_locate(args: {
    /** Exact filename to locate */
    filename: string;
    /** Search entire disk */
    global?: boolean;
  }): Promise<{ content: Array<{ type: "text"; text: string }> }>;

  /**
   * Recently worked or edited files in current workspace (frecency ranked).
   */
  function ultrasearch_recent(args?: {
    /** Max recent files (default: 15) */
    limit?: number;
  }): Promise<{ content: Array<{ type: "text"; text: string }> }>;

  /**
   * Toolchain latency metrics (p50/p90/p95), error rates, zero-hit queries, and recursive self-learning advice. Defaults to organic (non-gate) rows.
   */
  function ultrasearch_metrics(args?: {
    /** Audit provenance view (default: real = organic sessions only) */
    view?: "real" | "synthetic" | "all";
    /** Number of audit rows to analyze (default 1000) */
    limit?: number;
  }): Promise<{ content: Array<{ type: "text"; text: string }> }>;
}
